commercial_insights.reasoning: Analog Devices' investment in 300mm wafer capacity reduces manufacturing costs, providing a competitive advantage.

competitor_evidence.text: The Embedded Processing products are designed to handle specific tasks and can be optimized for various combinations of performance, power and cost.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: They are designed to handle specific tasks and can be optimized for various combinations of performance, power and cost, depending on the application.

competitor_evidence.text: Analog Devices' Embedded Processing products range from wireless connectivity and simple, low-cost devices such as microcontrollers to highly specialized devices such as radar and vision processing.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our products vary from wireless connectivity and simple, low-cost devices such as microcontrollers to highly specialized devices such as radar and vision processing.

competitor_evidence.text: The Embedded Processing products are used in many markets, particularly industrial and automotive.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Embedded Processing products are used in many markets, particularly industrial and automotive.

competitor_evidence.text: Customers often invest their own R&D to develop software that operates on Analog Devices' products.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: An important characteristic of our Embedded Processing products is that our customers often invest their own R&D to develop software that operates on our products.

competitor_evidence.text: The investment in R&D by customers tends to increase the length of customer relationships.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: This investment tends to increase the length of our customer relationships because many customers prefer to reuse software from one product generation to the next.

competitor_evidence.text: Semiconductor manufacturing begins with a sequence of photolithographic and chemical processing steps that fabricate a number of semiconductor devices on a thin silicon wafer.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Semiconductor manufacturing begins with a sequence of photolithographic and chemical processing steps that fabricate a number of semiconductor devices on a thin silicon wafer.

competitor_evidence.text: Analog Devices invests in manufacturing technologies and does most of its manufacturing in-house.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We invest in manufacturing technologies and do most of our manufacturing in-house.

competitor_evidence.text: Analog Devices' strategic decision to make manufacturing and technology a core competitive advantage provides tangible benefits of lower manufacturing costs and greater control of the supply chain.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: This strategic decision to make manufacturing and technology a core competitive advantage provides us with tangible benefits of lower manufacturing costs and greater control of our supply chain.

competitor_evidence.text: Analog Devices offers customers geopolitically dependable capacity.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: offering our customers geopolitically dependable capacity.

competitor_evidence.text: Analog Devices has focused on creating a competitive manufacturing structural cost advantage by investing in its 300mm capacity.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We have focused on creating a competitive manufacturing structural cost advantage by investing in our 300mm capacity.

competitor_evidence.text: An unpackaged chip built on a 300mm wafer costs about 40% less than an unpackaged chip built on a 200mm wafer.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: an unpackaged chip built on a 300mm wafer costs about 40% less than an unpackaged chip built on a 200mm wafer.
